concept.title: MissileX Integrated Defence Platform
concept.description: A futuristic, high-level research proposal exploring how advances in AI, aerospace engineering, and sensing systems could someday be studied together as a unified defence research concept.
concept.disclosureBody: This page describes a conceptual research proposal only. The MissileX Integrated Defence Platform does not exist as a built system, is not operational, and this page contains no engineering instructions, targeting logic, or weapon-construction detail.
concept.intro: Modern defence and space research increasingly draws on the same underlying disciplines — machine learning, distributed sensing, orbital mechanics, and systems integration. Rather than studying these fields in isolation, this research concept imagines a shared architecture that connects them at a conceptual level, purely for research, education, and long-range planning discussion.

privacy.title: Protecting research data, user privacy, and secure collaboration.
privacy.description: MissileX maintains strict controls for user data, research submissions, authentication flows, and email communications in alignment with enterprise-grade privacy practices.
privacy.p1: We collect user-provided registration data, contact submissions, and research information to provide platform services and review workflows. Sensitive information is only used for authentication, communication, and authorisation purposes.
privacy.p2: All messages and submissions are routed securely to the designated admin inbox; no data is shared externally without consent and strict access control.
privacy.p3: Users have the right to request data correction or account deletion through the secure portal contact mechanism.

terms.title: Terms for using the MissileX research platform.

terms.p1: Users are responsible for maintaining their account credentials and for all actions taken while signed in.
terms.p2: Research submissions and messages must be accurate and must not contain unauthorized or sensitive operational information.
terms.p3: MissileX reserves the right to suspend accounts that violate platform policies or compromise secure research workflows.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.description: Answers about the MissileX research portal, programmes, submissions, and accounts.

q1.question: What is MissileX Rocket Space?
q1.answer: MissileX Rocket Space is an independent research and education portal covering India's space and defence research ecosystem. It is not an official Government of India website, and it is not affiliated with ISRO, DRDO, or any armed forces branch.

q2.question: Can I submit a research project through this portal?
q2.answer: Yes. The Research Submission Portal accepts project documentation, PDF, PPT, image, video, and ZIP attachments up to 20MB, which are routed to the research review team.

q3.question: How do I apply to a research programme?
q3.answer: Visit the Programs page to review eligibility and apply. Application windows generally open twice yearly, in March and September.

q4.question: Is my account and submission data secure?
q4.answer: Authentication and session management are handled through Clerk, and submissions are routed to a controlled admin inbox. See the Privacy Policy for full details.

q5.question: Can I reach official government portals like ISRO or DRDO from here?
q5.answer: Yes. The Government Research Portal section on the homepage links directly to the official websites of ISRO, DRDO, the armed forces, and allied organisations, each opening in a new tab.

q6.question: Is the portal available in Hindi?
q6.answer: Yes. Use the English / हिंदी toggle in the top utility bar to switch the interface language at any time.

q7.question: How do I report an issue or share feedback?
q7.answer: Use the Feedback page to send comments, bug reports, or suggestions directly to the platform team.

q8.question: How can I request information about MissileX's operations?
q8.answer: See the Transparency & Information Access page for MissileX's voluntary information-disclosure policy and how to submit a request.

rti.title: Transparency & information access.
rti.description: MissileX Rocket Space is an independent research and education initiative, not a statutory public authority under the Right to Information Act, 2005, and has no obligation under that Act. In the spirit of the open-governance culture this portal draws inspiration from, we maintain the voluntary information-access policy below.

focus: Aerospace and defence research education, student programmes, research collaboration tools
authority: Not a public authority under the RTI Act, 2005 — this policy is voluntary

howSteps: Send a written request describing the information sought to the information contact above, or via the Feedback page.
Requests should relate to MissileX's own operations, policies, or published content — not to third-party government bodies linked from this portal.
We aim to acknowledge requests within a reasonable time and respond within 30 days on a best-effort, voluntary basis.
There is no fee for reasonable, standard information requests handled under this policy.
